analysis: The only change in docs/architecture/inference.md is documentation: a date bump at line 3, a clause at ~5253-5258 about a declared resident assistant adding launch arguments and an evidence digest to the pair-serving approval formula (ClusterPublicModels.tensorAssistant), and a Qwen27 resident-assistant paragraph near ~5379-5389. Durable checkpoints are bound to pinned shard SHA-256 hashes and the prompt-contract identity, and a post-load artifact hash mismatch is refused. The Qwen27 assistant discovery text is cut off. A later pass should check that the digest change matches the code and is enforced on both owner and member. No new attack surface or threat-model gaps were identified in the visible evidence.
